corrections.translation: 最終実重量には商品、小売箱、緩衝材、外箱が含まれます。寸法は完成した外装の縦、横、高さを測ります。最大の靴箱だけでは、他の品を同梱した外箱の大きさを過小評価します。反対に全箱の三辺を各方向とも足せば、並べたり重ねて収めたりできる分まで数えてしまいます。

corrections.source: A scale reports physical mass. Multiplying three dimensions gives a volume in the chosen cubic units. A route may convert that volume into a dimensional or volumetric billing figure according to its own rule. For routes that use such a comparison, you need the divisor, unit assumptions and any rounding specified by the route. Do not assume that a formula copied from another carrier or older parcel applies to the current result. Read the conditions for the exact line and destination in front of you.
corrections.translation: はかりで分かるのは実重量で、三辺を掛けると使用した単位に応じた体積になります。配送方法によっては独自の条件で容積重量に換算して料金を決めます。該当する宛先・配送方法の除数、単位、端数処理を確認します。他社や過去の荷物の計算式をそのまま使いません。

corrections.source: When the parcel is not packed yet, vary only the inputs you genuinely do not know. One scenario might retain a shoe box and another might omit it if removal is permitted and makes sense for that item. Keep destination, route and goods constant. Record any changes in protection. If the scenario with a smaller box needs extra material around the shoes, allow for that in the description rather than assuming that removing retail packaging removes every gram and centimetre associated with it.
corrections.translation: 未梱包なら不確かな条件だけを変えます。取り外しが許され、商品にも適切なら、靴箱を残す場合と外す場合を同じ商品、宛先、配送方法で試算します。保護方法の違いも記します。箱を外した後に靴へ別の緩衝材が必要なら、元の箱の重さと寸法がそのまま全て減るとは考えません。

corrections.source: If a result moves sharply between the two scenarios, investigate why. A size limit could exclude a route altogether. A charge may step up at a billing increment. A previously eligible route may disappear because the longest side changed. Record the threshold displayed in the live details, if any, rather than approximating from the list of prices. This lets you decide whether obtaining a more precise measurement would affect your choice. When both scenarios lead to the same decision within your budget, a more elaborate estimate may offer little advantage.
corrections.translation: 結果が大きく違えば、寸法制限、料金の刻み、最長辺による配送方法の除外など原因を調べます。一覧価格から推測せず、詳細画面に境界値が出ていれば控えます。より正確な採寸で判断が変わるかを考え、どちらも予算内で同じ選択になるなら、細かな試算を増やす必要は小さいでしょう。

corrections.source: Sugargoo describes pre-shipment package simulation as an optional service for obtaining a more precise packing result before final dispatch. Check the service details and fee currently offered. It is most informative when you have a decision waiting on the result: whether a parcel fits a particular route, whether to split contents, or whether keeping a bulky box remains practical. A measurement can only inform that decision if the simulated parcel actually matches the selection and packing instructions you care about.
corrections.translation: Sugargoo は本発送前に梱包結果を詳しく知るための任意サービスとして梱包シミュレーションを案内しています。現在の内容と料金を確認します。希望便に収まるか、分割するか、大きな箱を残すかの判断待ちなら役立ちます。対象品と梱包の指示が実際の発送予定に合っていることが前提です。

corrections.source: Before requesting the service, record the included warehouse entries, packaging decisions and destination. Ask what measurements and estimate the service will provide. When the result arrives, attach it to that exact scenario. If you later add a jacket, remove a box or change a reinforcement request, mark the old result as superseded. It can remain useful for comparison, but it no longer establishes the new parcel's packed characteristics. Keep optional simulation or packing charges separate from the freight estimate when comparing your total spend.
corrections.translation: 申込前に対象の入庫明細、包装の選択、宛先を記録し、どの実測値と見積もりを受け取れるか尋ねます。結果はその条件にひも付けます。上着を加える、箱を外す、補強を変えるなどしたら旧結果と明記し比較用に残します。 総額を比較する際は梱包シミュレーションや任意の作業料と運賃を分けます。

corrections.source: Read the quote line by line. Confirm the currency, route name, physical dimensions, actual mass and relevant billing basis. Look for included or separate service charges and any limit or condition that affects your destination. Compare the final amount with the last estimate using a short explanation of each change. “Box became five centimetres taller after protection was added” describes a physical change. “Quote viewed in a different currency” describes a display change. Separate explanations help you identify discrepancies that still need support.
corrections.translation: 見積もりの通貨、配送方法名、外寸、実重量、課金の根拠を一項目ずつ確認し、作業料の内訳や宛先条件も調べます。前回との差が「緩衝材を足して高さが五センチ増えた」なら物理的変化、「表示が別通貨」なら表示条件の変化です。切り分ければ、まだ問い合わせが必要な差が分かります。

corrections.source: If you have a question, send the two quote records with their dates, route names and parcel reference. State what stayed constant and which field changed. A message asking why an amount rose from one value to another is easier to answer when both values describe the same currency and parcel. After dispatch, save the final record with the actual contents. It gives you a more useful starting comparison for a future shipment than an isolated price per kilogram, because you know what was in the box, how it was packed and which conditions applied.
corrections.translation: 照会時は両方の見積もりに日付、配送方法名、荷物番号を添え、不変の条件と変化した欄を説明します。同じ通貨・荷物なら増額理由を調べやすくなります。発送後は最終記録を内容品とともに保存します。中身、梱包、条件が分かり、単独のキロ単価より次回の比較に役立ちます。

corrections.source: Photograph the box closed with the three measurements visible if you are recording your own example. An open flap can give a taller measurement than the parcel that actually travels.
corrections.translation: 自分で計測例を残すなら箱を閉じ、三辺の寸法が見えるように撮影します。ふたを開けたままでは実際に運ぶ箱より高く見積もる可能性があります。

corrections.source: Hold the box and destination constant, then compare eligibility, charges, delivery estimates, tracking and service conditions. The first price on the list seldom answers every question.
corrections.translation: 箱と宛先をそろえ、利用可否、料金、所要日数の目安、追跡、サービス条件を比べます。一覧の先頭価格だけでは判断できません。

corrections.source: A buyer shipping a gift for a particular occasion and a buyer replenishing basic clothing can reasonably make different choices from the same list of routes. Write down the purpose and which conditions are essential. Perhaps the deadline is flexible but detailed end-to-end tracking matters. Perhaps the contents include a fragile component, or the parcel's size is close to a limit. Treat those as filters before sorting by price. A route unable to carry the actual contents has no useful place in a cheapest-route ranking.
corrections.translation: 贈り物を行事に間に合わせる人と普段着を補充する人では、同じ一覧でも選ぶ便が違います。期限は柔軟でも詳細な追跡が必要なのか、壊れ物が入るのか、箱が寸法上限に近いのか、用途と必須条件を書きます。先に適合性で絞り、中身を運べる便だけで値段を比べます。

corrections.source: Make the comparison about one real parcel at a time. Use the same destination details, contents, packed measurements and actual mass for each route. Record the currency and date. If you are still estimating the box, label the comparison preliminary and keep the assumed measurements. Otherwise an attractive change in price may come from a smaller default box or different displayed currency rather than any advantage of the shipping line. Sugargoo's estimator guide describes opening each option to see its detailed conditions and charge breakdown.
corrections.translation: 比較は一つの実際の荷物について行い、宛先、内容、梱包後の寸法、実重量を全便でそろえ、日付と通貨を控えます。未梱包なら仮の寸法と暫定比較であることを書きます。安く見える理由が既定の箱や表示通貨の違いかもしれません。Sugargoo の試算ガイドでは各候補の条件・料金内訳の開き方を案内しています。

corrections.source: Read the size and weight limits for the specific destination and service. Check the longest side as well as any combined dimension formula. A compact heavy box can fail a weight limit while a long light box fails a length limit. If the calculator uses a contents category, select the correct one. When eligibility remains uncertain, ask the platform with the item's actual description. Avoid relying on an example shipment that used a similarly named line to a different country or at a different time.
corrections.translation: 該当する宛先・サービスの寸法と重量の上限を確認します。最長辺だけでなく複数辺を組み合わせる式も見ます。小さく重い箱は重量、長く軽い箱は長さで外れることがあります。内容品の分類は正しく選び、不明なら実物の説明を添えて相談します。他国向けや過去の同名便の例だけでは判断しません。

corrections.source: For each remaining route, note how the detail page describes its billing basis. It may distinguish initial and continued weight increments or list operating charges and other components. Copy the total and its itemization together. If the displayed breakdown already sums to the total, do not add the initial or continued-weight amount a second time. When an entry is conditional on a destination or service choice, mark it conditional rather than treating it as a confirmed zero for every address.
corrections.translation: 候補ごとに料金詳細の根拠を控えます。最初の重量枠、追加重量、作業料などがあれば、合計と内訳を一緒に残します。すでに合計に入る項目をもう一度加えません。宛先やサービスの選択次第で発生する料金は条件付きと記し、どの住所でもゼロとは扱いません。

corrections.source: Record the wording of the delivery estimate, its starting event and any caveats displayed for the line. An interval associated with carrier dispatch is different from the full time since you first bought the product. Seller fulfillment, domestic delivery and warehouse processing may already have taken place before the international estimate becomes relevant. If you need a gift by a fixed date, compare the remaining time with the actual parcel stage, leaving room for uncertainty rather than treating an estimated interval as a guaranteed arrival.
corrections.translation: 配送日数の表記、起算点、注記を控えます。運送会社の発送からの日数は、商品を買ってからの全期間とは違います。販売店の手配、国内便、倉庫作業は国際配送の起算前にあります。期限のある贈り物は、今の進捗から残り日数を比較し、目安を到着保証として扱いません。

corrections.source: Pay attention to the type of tracking information available. Does the selected service identify the final-mile carrier or explain how to follow a local handoff? Can you associate the international tracking number with the correct parcel? A route that gives fewer scans may still deliver, but it may be a poor fit for someone who needs to coordinate receipt. Ask what the line promises and distinguish that from anecdotes about frequent scans on another buyer's shipment. A familiar carrier name alone cannot settle how a particular service is tracked.
corrections.translation: 最終配達を担当する会社や現地引渡し後の追跡方法が示されているか、国際番号がこの荷物に対応するかを見ます。履歴が少ない便でも届きますが、受取調整が必要な人には合わない場合があります。他人の荷物の履歴頻度や有名な運送会社名より、そのサービスが何を案内するかを確認します。

corrections.source: Review the route's stated conditions for claims, damage, prohibited contents and any optional service. Keep the details applicable to your parcel and route. General marketing descriptions may not establish the outcome for a fragile item or an item packed without its retail box. If a rule is central to the decision, save the current wording and ask a narrowly framed question before paying. Give the actual material, packing and destination so that the response concerns the case you are considering.
corrections.translation: 補償請求、破損、禁制品、任意サービスの条件を読み、該当する荷物・便の規定を保存します。壊れ物や小売箱を外した品への対応は一般的な宣伝文だけでは決まりません。重要な条件は支払い前に現行の文面を残し、材質、包装、宛先を明示して具体的に質問します。

corrections.source: Do not confuse better photographs with better protection or a service charge with comprehensive coverage. Packing choices can reduce certain visible risks, but a warehouse photo of a sealed carton cannot prove all internal conditions. Insurance or compensation language has its own terms, limits and evidence requirements. When two routes differ in these respects, describe the difference in practical language: which evidence would you need, which exclusions are relevant and what unresolved uncertainty remains? Then decide whether that change matters enough to influence your choice.
corrections.translation: 写真の鮮明さと保護の程度、作業料と包括的な補償は別です。梱包で減らせるリスクはありますが、封箱後の画像から内部の全状態は分かりません。保険・補償には条件、限度、必要な証拠があります。候補ごとに必要資料、関係する除外事項、残る不明点を書き、その差が選択に影響するか判断します。

corrections.source: If the box has not been packed, repeat the comparison for a reasonable narrower or taller arrangement without changing the destination or contents. A route sensitive to dimensional weight can move in the ranking when a retail box remains. Another route using a different basis may change less. A line near a size threshold may disappear entirely. Record why the result changed. The purpose of testing a second scenario is to identify fragile assumptions, not to pick the lowest figure from mutually incompatible inputs.
corrections.translation: 未梱包なら、宛先・内容を保ち、少し細長い、あるいは背の高い現実的な配置でも比較します。小売箱を残すと容積重量を使う便の順位が変わり、他方式の便は変化が小さい場合があります。寸法上限付近の便は候補から消えるかもしれません。理由を記録し、両立しない前提から最安値だけを拾わないようにします。

corrections.source: If a small change reverses the choice and the decision affects a significant part of your budget, consider whether more reliable packing measurements are available. Sugargoo describes a package-simulation service for reducing pre-dispatch uncertainty. Check the price and applicable process before using it. A more precise figure is valuable when it lets you choose between eligible alternatives; it adds less when both scenarios already lead to the same decision. Once you change contents or instructions, revisit any earlier measured result.
corrections.translation: わずかな寸法差で選択が逆転し予算への影響も大きいなら、確かな梱包寸法が得られるか調べます。Sugargoo は本発送前の梱包シミュレーションを案内しているため、現在の料金と手順を確認します。利用可能な便の選択が変わるなら実測には価値があります。中身や指示を変えたら以前の実測を見直します。

corrections.source: Write a short final comparison with one row per eligible route. Include the quote, date, currency, billing basis, applicable limits, delivery estimate and any service condition that drove the decision. Then state the choice in a sentence: “I selected line B because the verified box fits its size limit, the full price is within budget and its tracking conditions match how I can receive the parcel.” This preserves the reason even if a screen later displays different prices or a similarly named line.
corrections.translation: 利用できる便ごとに一行を使い、見積額、日付、通貨、課金根拠、上限、日数の目安、決め手となった条件を控えます。「実測の箱が制限内で総額も予算内、追跡条件も受取に合うので B 便を選んだ」のように理由を一文で残せば、後で価格や似た名称の便が変わっても判断を振り返れます。

corrections.source: After packing, compare the final quote and route with that record before completing payment. If the numbers differ, first check whether the readings describe the same parcel, route, currency and service selection. Once the parcel has shipped, use the outbound record's tracking rather than a domestic seller number. At delivery, note what happened as experience with this specific shipment. A single successful or delayed delivery can inform your preferences, but it does not establish permanent price, speed or reliability rankings for all future Sugargoo parcels.
corrections.translation: 梱包後、決済前に最終便と見積もりを記録と比べます。差があれば荷物、便、通貨、サービス選択が同じか確認します。発送後は販売店の国内番号ではなく発送荷物の番号で追跡します。到着結果は今回の経験として記録します。一度の順調な配達や遅延で、今後すべての Sugargoo 荷物の価格・速さ・信頼性の順位は決まりません。

corrections.source: For a gift with a fixed occasion, record the last date the delivery would still be useful. Compare that date with the full handling and transit sequence. A route displayed as faster may still miss the occasion if the warehouse has yet to finish packing.
corrections.translation: 行事用の贈り物なら、いつまでに届けば役立つかを記し、作業と輸送の全工程に照らします。倉庫の梱包が終わっていなければ、表示上速い便でも間に合わない場合があります。

corrections.source: Extra photos, packing decisions and a pre-shipment simulation may apply at different stages. Compare each service with the decision it supports, then record its price against the right item or parcel.
corrections.translation: 追加撮影、梱包方法の指定、発送前の梱包シミュレーションは段階が異なります。何の判断に使うかを見極め、料金を対象の商品や荷物に記録します。

corrections.source: A small additional charge can be perfectly reasonable and still make the final total difficult to explain. The usual problem is losing track of what it applied to. A detail photograph may concern one warehouse item. A packing request may concern several pieces in a single parcel. A pre-shipment simulation may help compare an arrangement before dispatch. Record each service with its object: purchase line, physical item, proposed parcel or actual outbound parcel. That one field prevents a parcel-wide charge from being counted once for every item inside it.
corrections.translation: 少額でも対象が分からなくなると合計の説明が難しくなります。詳細写真は倉庫の一品、梱包指定は一箱の複数品、シミュレーションは発送候補の配置に対するものかもしれません。購入明細、現物、予定荷物、実際の発送荷物のどれが対象かを書けば、一箱分の料金を中身の点数だけ重ねて数えるのを防げます。

corrections.source: Start from the service offered on the actual order screen and read what is included. Sugargoo's QC guide discusses standard inspection and circumstances in which further pictures may be useful. Its package-simulation guide describes a separate optional process for reducing uncertainty about a packed shipment. These services answer different questions. A photograph that confirms the size of a jacket does not establish the parcel's packed weight. A precise packed weight does not tell you whether the jacket was the ordered size. Match the service to the uncertainty you are paying to resolve.
corrections.translation: 実際の注文画面でサービス内容を読みます。Sugargoo の検品案内は通常検品と追加写真が役立つ場合を、梱包シミュレーションの案内は別の任意サービスを説明しています。上着のサイズ写真で梱包後重量は分からず、正確な重量で上着のサイズは確認できません。解決したい疑問に合わせます。

corrections.source: Complete this sentence in your own words: “If this service gives me the requested information, I will decide whether to…” For example, a measurement photo could help you decide whether to keep the medium size. A packing simulation might help you choose between keeping both retail boxes and splitting the contents. If the result could not change your decision, look again at why you are selecting it. It may provide peace of mind, but record that as your reason rather than assuming the service will save a particular amount of money.
corrections.translation: 「結果が出たら何を決めるか」を先に言葉にします。採寸写真なら M を残すか、梱包試算なら小売箱二つを残すか荷物を分けるか、などです。どんな結果でも判断が変わらないなら理由を考え直します。安心のためならそう記し、特定額の節約が確実とは考えません。

corrections.source: The requested output should be observable. “Check quality” is broad. “Photograph the closed jacket from underarm seam to underarm seam with the tape visible” describes a view you can evaluate. “Reduce shipping cost” is not a packing instruction. “Compare an arrangement with the printed shoebox kept intact against one without the outer seller carton, if those options are available” identifies the change under consideration. Read any service limitations and decide whether the platform can actually provide the outcome you need before recording it as purchased.
corrections.translation: 「品質確認」より「閉じた上着の脇の縫い目から反対の脇まで、メジャーが見える写真」の方が確認できます。「送料を下げる」も梱包指示になりません。利用できるなら、印刷された靴箱を残す配置と販売店の外箱を外す配置の比較を頼みます。申込前に、欲しい結果がサービスの範囲かを読みます。

corrections.source: A workable service ledger has a date, reference, description, original currency, amount, charging unit and payment status. Keep quoted, selected, paid, cancelled and refunded entries distinguishable. Seeing an optional charge on a screen does not establish that you paid it. Likewise, a paid service may be included in an order or parcel total already. Copy the confirmed total and the itemization separately so you can tell whether a line is part of the total or an addition to it.
corrections.translation: サービスの台帳に日付、番号、説明、元の通貨、金額、課金単位、決済状況を設けます。見積、選択、支払、取消、返金を区別します。表示された任意料金が支払済みとは限らず、支払った料金が注文・荷物の合計に含まれる場合もあります。確定総額と内訳を別々に残します。

corrections.source: If several people share an international parcel, an optional service may benefit one buyer or the entire shipment. A measurement photo requested for one person's jacket can reasonably go against that item. A parcel-level reinforcement charge may be split equally, allocated by item value or assigned under another agreement. None of those internal methods changes what the platform charged. Agree on the method before distributing the cost and keep the original parcel-wide charge visible for reconciliation.
corrections.translation: 共同発送で、一人の上着を測る写真はその品の費用にできます。一箱の補強料は均等、商品額に比例、その他の合意で分けられます。内部の配分でプラットフォームの請求額は変わりません。先に配分方法を決め、一箱分の元の料金も照合用に残します。

corrections.source: A service selected for a particular arrangement can lose its relevance when the contents change. If a simulation concerned a jacket, shoes and their two retail boxes, record the result with that exact selection. Removing a box, adding another item or changing reinforcement instructions can alter the resulting size and weight. The money already spent on the service remains a historical cost. Its result may help your reasoning, but it does not establish the final dimensions of a different package.
corrections.translation: 上着、靴、小売箱二つを対象に試したなら、その組み合わせの結果として残します。箱の取り外し、品の追加、補強の変更で寸法・重量は変わりえます。支払済みの料金は過去の費用として残り、前の結果は比較に使えても別構成の最終寸法を証明しません。

corrections.source: If you request a revised service, distinguish the initial charge from the new quote and check how the platform handles the change in your case. Do not presume a second request is free or automatically billed. Record what is offered and what you accept. If the earlier result is superseded, keep it marked as such rather than deleting it. You can then explain why the service ledger contains two records for one eventual parcel and identify whether one was only a quote, an adjustment or a completed separate service.
corrections.translation: 再依頼では最初の料金と新しい見積もりを分け、今回の変更の扱いを確認します。二回目が無料とも自動請求とも限りません。提示と了承の内容を残し、古い結果は消さず旧版と記します。一つの発送荷物に二記録ある場合でも、見積、調整、完了した別作業のどれか説明できます。

corrections.source: When a photograph arrives, compare it with the request before closing the entry. Does it show the correct item, the specified feature and sufficient detail? For a measurement, can you read both endpoints and the units? For a packing result, do the contents and instructions match the scenario you asked about? Record the observation or the unresolved question. Paying for a service and obtaining useful evidence are separate events. If clarification is needed, cite the request and what is missing from the returned result.
corrections.translation: 写真が届いたら品物、指定箇所、細部を確認します。採寸なら両端と単位が読めるか、梱包なら内容と指示が依頼どおりかを見ます。観察と未解決の疑問を書きます。支払いと有用な証拠の入手は別の段階です。追加確認には元の依頼と不足している点を示します。

corrections.source: Avoid upgrading the meaning of the evidence after the fact. A close photograph showing a clean seam supports an observation about that visible seam. It does not verify the long-term durability of the garment. A picture of a closed box confirms some external features but cannot show every internal layer. A packing estimate can narrow uncertainty without guaranteeing that carrier handling will never alter a final billed amount. Describe the result at the level it supports. This makes later comparison of the service's value much more informative.
corrections.translation: きれいな縫い目の接写は見える縫い目の状態を示すだけで、耐久性は保証しません。閉じた箱の写真に全ての内装は写りません。梱包見積もりで不確実さは減っても、運送会社の最終請求が変わらない保証にはなりません。証拠の範囲で説明すればサービスの価値を比べやすくなります。

corrections.source: At the end, reconcile the original currency amounts before converting or dividing them. Add confirmed merchandise, confirmed domestic charges, actual outbound freight and separately paid services once each. Subtract only confirmed credits or refunds and keep pending adjustments labelled. If the figures do not match, isolate the service with the unclear status or inclusion rule. A small undocumented entry can be investigated more efficiently when the rest of the ledger has already been reconciled.
corrections.translation: 換算・配分前に元通貨で照合します。確定した商品代、国内料金、実際の発送運賃、別払いの作業料を一度ずつ加え、確定した返金・充当だけを差し引きます。未確定の調整は別にし、合わなければ状態や総額への算入が不明なサービスに絞ります。

corrections.source: Keep a short note on usefulness rather than just price. “Measurement answered the size question before dispatch” identifies a service worth considering for a similar purchase. “Simulation used an arrangement we changed afterwards” is a reminder to finalize the contents earlier next time. Neither conclusion establishes that every buyer should select or avoid the service. Your record connects a particular extra to its real cost, the information it delivered and the decision you made. That is the comparison worth carrying forward to the next Sugargoo order.
corrections.translation: 値段だけでなく「採寸で発送前にサイズを判断できた」「試算後に構成を変えたので次は先に固める」と用途を書きます。全員に勧めるかどうかではなく、その費用、得た情報、実際の判断を結び付けると、次の Sugargoo 注文に生かせます。

corrections.source: For a service shared by several items, write down who authorized it and the allocation you agreed. The parcel receipt need only show the charge once.
corrections.translation: 複数品で共有するサービスは、誰が承認しどう配分することにしたかを控えます。荷物の領収記録に載せる元の料金は一回分です。

corrections.source: Rebuild the final amount from the parcel, route and service lines that actually shipped. A change from an early estimate is easier to investigate when measurement, currency and payment are reconciled separately.
corrections.translation: 実際に発送した荷物、配送方法、サービスの明細から最終額を組み立てます。採寸、通貨、決済を分けて照合すると当初との差を調べやすくなります。

corrections.source: Find the outbound parcel record whose packing and freight charges you want to check. Write down its reference, destination, route and included warehouse entries. Then locate the earlier estimate you remember comparing. Do the contents match? A final parcel containing a jacket and two shoe boxes is not the same as a shopping-stage estimate for the jacket alone. Before investigating a charge, establish that the two numbers concern the same object. If the selection changed intentionally, record that change as the first explanation rather than treating it as a billing error.
corrections.translation: 確認対象の荷物番号、宛先、配送方法、同梱した入庫明細を記し、以前の見積もりと比べます。上着と靴箱二つを入れた最終箱は、購入時に上着だけで試算した箱とは違います。同じ対象の数字かを先に確かめ、意図的に選択を変えた場合は請求ミスを疑う前にその変化を記録します。

corrections.source: Keep the purchase ledger out of the initial comparison. Seller item price and seller-to-warehouse delivery are relevant to your entire shopping budget, but they do not belong inside the outbound freight calculation unless the statement explicitly identifies an adjustment of that kind. Sugargoo's simulation guide explains the difference between an estimate based on pre-packing information and the amount calculated after packing. Use the shipping statement to understand that stage, then bring the reconciled figure back into your overall purchase budget at the end.
corrections.translation: まず購入台帳を切り離します。商品代と販売店から倉庫までの送料は全体予算には関係しますが、明示された調整がなければ発送運賃の計算には入れません。Sugargoo の梱包案内は梱包前の情報による試算と梱包後の計算の違いを説明しています。発送明細を照合してから全体予算に戻します。

corrections.source: Copy the packed external length, width, height and actual mass from the final record where shown. Beside them, enter the values used in your earlier estimate and their source. A seller's product dimensions, warehouse item dimensions and outer parcel dimensions can differ substantially. If any figures are missing, mark them unknown. An investigation based on actual packed mass and guessed box size is not yet a complete explanation of a dimensional difference.
corrections.translation: 最終記録に表示された外箱の縦、横、高さ、実重量と、以前の入力値・出所を並べます。商品ページ、倉庫の単品、発送用外箱では寸法が大きく異なる場合があります。不明値は不明とします。梱包後の実重量だけが確かで箱寸法が推測なら、寸法差の説明はまだ不十分です。

corrections.source: Read the detailed route conditions for the same service and destination. Look for how it defines billed weight, initial weight, continued weight and rounding where those terms appear. Compare actual and volumetric figures only under the rule shown for that route. If the route uses physical mass for your parcel, a large-looking dimensional difference may be irrelevant to its price. A different route with a similar name or a different destination cannot supply a missing divisor or rate with confidence.
corrections.translation: 同じ配送方法・宛先の詳細から、課金重量、最初と追加の重量枠、端数処理を読みます。実重量と容積重量はその便の規定で比較します。この荷物を実重量で課金するなら、外寸の大きな差が料金には無関係な場合もあります。別の宛先や似た名称の便の除数・単価では補えません。

corrections.source: If the statement separates the initial and continued portions, identify whether the displayed weight is already rounded to a billing increment. For a hypothetical service charging in half-kilogram increments, a small increase across a boundary can change the charge even if the scale mass barely moves. This example illustrates a mechanism rather than any current platform policy. Use the actual statement's units and rule. If you cannot reconstruct the calculation because one component is hidden, ask for that component instead of inventing the missing rate.
corrections.translation: 初乗りと追加分が分かれていれば、表示重量がすでに料金刻みに丸められているか確認します。仮に半キロ刻みなら、実重量が少し増えただけでも境界をまたいで料金が変わります。これは仕組みの例で、実際は明細の単位と規定を使います。再計算に必要な項目がなければ、単価を推測せず問い合わせます。

corrections.source: Copy the displayed total once. Then list the components shown as included within it, such as route freight or operating entries if present. Make another list of separately paid optional services. Determine from the payment record whether each amount is inside the confirmed total or was charged additionally. A simulation purchased earlier might be associated with the parcel while having been paid in a separate transaction. A visible line can be an explanation of the total rather than an invitation to add it again.
corrections.translation: 表示総額は一度だけ控え、その内訳の運賃や作業料と、別払いの任意サービスを別々に列挙します。各金額が含まれるかは決済記録で確認します。先に購入した梱包試算が荷物にひも付いていても別決済かもしれません。明細行は合計の説明で、再加算する項目とは限りません。

corrections.source: Confirm that the earlier and later figures are in the same currency. A shopping catalogue can show converted prices for convenience while an account balance or payment receipt uses another currency. Even if the parcel charge was unchanged in the original currency, the amount on a card statement may differ because of the rate or payment processing. Track what the platform charged and what the payment provider settled as related but distinct records. Do not infer a warehouse adjustment from a bank-side difference until the original currency amounts have been compared.
corrections.translation: 比較額の通貨をそろえます。カタログの換算表示と残高や領収書の通貨は違う場合があります。元の運賃が同じでも為替や決済処理でカードの確定額が変わることがあります。プラットフォーム請求と決済業者の精算を関連する別記録として扱い、元通貨の比較前に銀行側の差を倉庫の調整とみなしません。

corrections.source: If there was an initial payment followed by a request for more, record both transaction amounts and whether the later figure is an additional charge or a revised total. Similarly, distinguish a credit shown in an account balance from a refund already received via the original payment method. Use the actual status and destination shown. A pending adjustment should remain pending in your reconciliation. A historical payment screenshot combined with a new full statement can double the apparent cost if you add them without identifying which amount replaces the other.
corrections.translation: 先払い後に追加請求があれば両額を記し、後の数字が追加分か改訂総額かを調べます。口座残高への返還と元の決済手段への返金完了も区別し、実際の状態と返還先を記します。未確定は未確定のままです。過去の支払画面と新しい全額明細を単純に足すと二重計上になりえます。

corrections.source: Once the parcel selection, measurements, billing basis, currency and separately paid services have been reconciled, write down the unexplained amount. Give support the parcel reference, route and dates of the two records. State the specific difference: “Both figures are in the same currency and use the same recorded billing weight. I can account for the route and packing lines but cannot identify the additional amount shown here.” Include only the relevant statement sections through the proper order channel, keeping unrelated payment or personal details out of publicly shared images.
corrections.translation: 選択品、採寸、課金根拠、通貨、別払いを合わせた上で、説明できない額を特定します。窓口に荷物番号、便、両記録の日付を添え、「通貨と課金重量は同じで、運賃と梱包分は合いますが、この追加額の項目が分かりません」と尋ねます。注文窓口に必要な部分だけ示し、公開画像に不要な決済・個人情報を載せません。

corrections.source: If the difference relates to physical packing, attach the relevant instructions. For example, you may have requested retention of a retail carton after the estimate was made; that can alter dimensions. If the parcel was simulated before the contents changed, identify the earlier and later selection. If the actual packing seems inconsistent with an agreed service, distinguish that service question from the arithmetic. A statement can add up correctly while still describing a different packing arrangement from the one you expected.
corrections.translation: 梱包が原因なら指示を添えます。試算後に小売箱を残すよう頼めば外寸は変わりえます。試し梱包後に内容を変えたなら前後の品目を示します。合意した梱包との相違は算数とは別のサービスの問題です。合計が正しくても想定とは別の梱包を示す明細の場合があります。

corrections.source: A useful closing note names each confirmed cause and any unresolved point. “The final box was taller after protection, the route used the measured billing weight, and the separate photo fee was already paid on the item” describes which records changed and which did not. Avoid a broad conclusion that a platform always charges more or less than its estimates. The information available before packing and the specific choice of route and contents determine how meaningful a particular estimate was.
corrections.translation: 最後に確認できた原因と未解決点を書きます。「緩衝材で箱が高くなり、便は実測課金重量を採用、追加写真は品目側で支払済み」なら何が変わったか具体的です。一例で常に見積もりより高い・安いと決めつけず、梱包前に分かった情報や便、内容品を踏まえて評価します。

corrections.source: For your next shipment, save the final packed dimensions, actual mass, contents, route and final freight together. They provide a starting comparison for a similar parcel, especially if the same type of box and protection will be used. Treat the old price as historical rather than a current quote. Run the new parcel through the live conditions and estimator, then label its stage. The reward for reading this statement carefully is a better question next time: which input is still uncertain enough to change the decision before you pay?
corrections.translation: 最終外寸、実重量、内容品、配送方法、確定運賃を一緒に保存します。似た箱・緩衝材を使う次回の比較に役立ちますが、古い価格は過去の記録です。新しい荷物は現行の条件で試算して段階を記し、決済前にどの未確定の入力が判断を変えうるかを見ます。

corrections.source: Once the statement balances, save an offline copy beside the packing result. Give both documents the same parcel identifier so you can find them even after the tracking view changes.
corrections.translation: 照合後は明細の控えを梱包結果の隣にオフライン保存します。両書類に同じ荷物番号を付けておけば、後で追跡画面が変わっても見つけられます。
